_comment: can-tools, whose canbench/ is the CAN adapter package gen-inhibit uses (vehicle_runner.py's --interface auto, and the tester's Kvaser opener in the bench harness), at one commit (AGENTS.md, "can-tools"; user, 2026-10-30: each project pins its own can-tools and moves the pin itself; the pin is the implementor's, reviewer 2026-10-30 and 2026-11-11). can_tools_pin.py writes that commit's canbench/ out of the CAN_TOOLS_DIR clone into the worktree's scratch/can-tools/<commit>/ and refuses any other canbench. fa6c0ae (2026-11-11) adds canbench.live.linux_fixes, without which no Kvaser channel opens on Linux.
